definitions.explanation: An event to be celebrated, such as a wedding, a birth or entering school. Often set against {弔|とむら}い{事|ごと} or {不祝儀|ぶしゅうぎ} (funerals and other occasions of mourning) in etiquette.

examples.japanese: {祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
examples.english: We make red rice for celebrations.

examples.japanese: {祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水引|みずひき}→水引：29258_mizuhiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: A gift for a happy occasion is usually tied with a red-and-white mizuhiki cord.

notes:
⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧ (celebration) + {事|こと} (matter, affair). Common in talk about etiquette: gifts, envelopes, colors and taboo words differ for happy and sad occasions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a happy event coming up
- {祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: a celebratory gathering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {慶事|けいじ}: happy event, the formal word
- ⟦{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→祝儀：06225_shuugi⟧: celebration; a gift of money for one
- {弔|とむら}い{事|ごと}: an occasion of mourning, the opposite
